correctness.rationale: The factor multiset is precisely the edge-multiplicity data of the binary order-two de Bruijn graph. The last-exit decomposition classifies singleton Euler trails by support in-arborescences and exact local ordering binomial factors. The symbolic script exhausts all 256 support masks and all possible distinct endpoints, generates 136 feasible nonzero cases and certifies exact rational-function cancellation. The independent standard-library brute checker verifies all source words through n=18; n=112 coefficients verify recurrence, but the proof does not rely on finite extrapolation. The unit-root pole analysis yields 1/2 n^2+14n+O(1).
